label: Browser Research
summary: Research runtime optimized for source discovery, citation discipline, and empty-result recovery.
claim_notes: Research policy is inferred from general web-retrieval and citation requirements.
It does not imply any specific model can browse without the host providing tools.
failure_modes: Treating empty results as proof too early
rules: Search before answering factual or current claims.
Prefer primary sources when they exist.
Track source dates and distinguish source text from inference.
Retry weak or empty results with broader queries.
